Synthetic 220Hz sine generated with FFmpeg/libmp3lame for MP3 decoder regression testing. Not a user reference recording. Generated test audio may be used and redistributed with this project.

`v041/` and `CrushDSP-v041.h` freeze the v0.2.41 DSP stages and signed character weights for exact recall checks. Analysis/profile types are shared and unchanged. These are source fixtures, not audio.
